policy_values.organization: All resources in the selected organization, subject to server filtering and installation ceilings.
policy_values.delegated_organization: Organization scope only when an explicit server capability has been delegated.
policy_values.operational_safe_subset: Only allowlisted non-secret, reversible or safely stoppable operational actions.
policy_values.own: Only resources owned by the authenticated user inside the selected organization.
policy_values.server_filtered_read: Read-only projection selected by the server; hidden data is never fetched and hidden only in the client.
policy_values.personal: Only the authenticated user's personal profile, preferences, sessions, and audit data.
policy_values.visibility_scoped: Only documents whose server-side visibility policy includes the role or capability.

route_migrations.rule: Uninitialized installation goes to setup; an authenticated user goes to dashboard; otherwise login.
Arbitrary self-registration is not a canonical local-platform route. Preserve the URL only as a state-aware compatibility gateway.
Preserve recognized filters and selection context; do not expose credentials in the redirect URL.
Map recognized legacy tabs to their canonical nested route before applying the default profile route.
Keep `/models` canonical; preserve recognized model selection context and discard unrelated strategy-only query parameters.
Unknown IDs return 404, unauthenticated access preserves the canonical target in a sanitized `next`, and insufficient visibility returns 403.

Reserve `/docs` for versioned user documentation. Disable framework documentation on both Web and core API applications by default; when explicitly enabled for development, expose each application under its own authenticated `/_internal/*` namespace and do not proxy an anonymous `/api/docs` alias.

current_enforcement_findings.finding: The SSR Web gate primarily distinguishes anonymous from authenticated users and does not carry the target organization role matrix.
The identity domain implements owner/admin/operator/trader/viewer and a permission map, while installation_owner is stored as separate authority.
Strategy and backtest routes primarily enforce authenticated user ownership and runtime checks, not the complete target role matrix.
Administrative routes enforce organization permissions and installation_owner for installation actions, but operator `operations.execute` requires a narrower target safe-action allowlist.
Connection credential mutations have same-origin and recent-auth guards, but target organization-role differentiation is not fully implemented.
